correctness.rationale: Every length at most 15 factors through exactly 64 residue/high-bit states, with each state weight \(1/64\) proved using the odd-part valuation density. A complete 960-case checker yields all 28 palindrome factors and exact state multiplicities, and absence at lengths 14 and 15 rules out all longer lengths via centered subfactors. Direct checks of 786432 windows are supplementary, not the infinite proof. The exact occurrence rule follows from the same state construction.

value.rationale: The regular paperfolding word is a canonical automatic sequence; its palindrome factor counts and length cutoff do not supply individual occurrence probabilities. The result gives exact frequencies for all 28 individual palindromes, proves uniformity within each length and gives a position-level automatic 64-state rule. This is a complete natural invariant classification with potential use in factor-frequency and automata analyses, not an arbitrary finite window or routine restatement of the known length cutoff.
